Registry FixedAssetRegisterApplet 'Fixed Asset' (title changed from 'Fixed Asset Applet'; documentation_url = Confluence, no alias needed - all 6 inbound links already use /applets/finance/fixed-asset-applet/). Full rewrite of a 591-line guide-voice page into a 599-line reference. Applet-LOCAL settings and AppletSettingsModule IS imported, but Field Settings is the unbound 8-toggle stub; Default Selection is real and only ASSET_REGISTER_DETAILS_TAB_ORDER is consumed (DEFAULT_BRANCH/DEFAULT_LOCATION/DEFAULT_COMPANY saved, never read); everything else in applet-settings.model.ts is model-only. Headline findings: the depreciation processor drops both journal lines because it filters on fi_depr_subledger_guid / fi_acc_depr_subledger_guid, which nothing in the applet or backend ever sets - the journal is created empty and no validator objects; the run's asset selection ignores the run header's company and branch and keeps BaseQueryCriteria's default limit of 100; the stop condition is accumulated <= residual so with residual 0 the asset is flagged DEPRECIATED on the first run and later lines plus journals are permanently deleted; ACTUAL_DAY averaging implements only STRAIGHT_LINE; depr_rate is a bare monthly multiplier; the purchase-invoice conversion endpoint is an AnonymousTenantEndpoint; a negative Adjustment posts a line with an unassigned GL code; Description has no input on either form; Permission Wizard / Release Notes / Applet Log render in the settings menu with no route while feature-visibility / webhook / team-permission-listing have routes and no link. 6 of 16 images dropped - quarantine list in findings run 31. Topic kb/topics/fixed-asset-register.md (new).

Registry InternalRmaApplet 'Rma Applet (Internal)' (title changed from 'RMA (Internal) Applet'; the registry documentation_url already points at this page, no alias needed). Full rewrite of a 289-line guide-voice page into a 455-line reference. Applet-LOCAL settings and the counter-example to the unbound 8-toggle stub: 82 keys declared, all 82 rendered, all 82 persisted in one saveMasterSettingsInit, 68 consumed; dead are HIDE_CUSTRMA_DOC_NO, HIDE_SUPRTV_DOC_NO, HIDE_WORKFLOW_STATUS, HIDE_WORKFLOW_RESOLUTION and ITEM_CATEGORY_GROUP_1..10. Key findings: three unrelated record types behind one applet (bl_svc_issue_hdr service note; INTERNAL_SALES_RMA 0/0 - no stock, no journal, so a Customer RMA neither restocks nor credits; INTERNAL_SUPPLIER_RTV +1/+1); RMA Requests is a FOURTH approval engine (SVCApprovalStatus on bl_svc_issue_request_hdr, no settings screen, approving enqueues SVC_ISSUE_REQUEST_HDR_PROCESSOR which casts the request row into bl_svc_issue_hdr, guarded only by svc_issue_hdr_guid IS NULL) and a login-entity-ep lets a customer or supplier raise its own request; this applet is the sole consumer of the Workflow Design engine, with three independent process settings and a per-company binding; return reasons, request actions and the RMA Report are gated by TNT_API_DM_SVC_ISSUE_HDR_* rather than their own families; HIDE_BRANCH/HIDE_LOCATION remove controls that keep Validators.required. Every entry the shared settings shell renders here does have a route - the first applet in this lane where that is true. 16 of 22 images dropped (staff names, e-mails and phone numbers in grids; a person's photo, name and e-mail on Personalization; an AI infographic inventing a 6-step lifecycle) - quarantine list in findings run 31. Topic kb/topics/rma-and-service-notes.md (new).
